title: Avgolemono Soup
description: A traditional Greek soup made with chicken broth, eggs, and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: 1. In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
2. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
4. Stir in the avgolemono and lemon juice.
5. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
6. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and a splash of the hot broth.
7. Stir the egg mixture back into the soup.
8. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the soup has thickened slightly.
9. Stir in the cooked rice and chopped dill.
10. Serve hot, garnished with additional dill if desired.
